124: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.

A trip back in time from the present to...

Lawrence 'Larry' Stewart Talbot / The Wolf Man

Queen Doris of the Sixth Dimension

The Incredible True Story of Formula One's Greatest Family.

Two get on. One gets off.

For whom sails to a new life...

An action movie with Björn Skifs made by Jonas Frick

Passionate... Exciting... Intriguing... He bartered his soul for the SECRET of the cards!

Alaric de Marnac / Hugo de Marnac / Armand de Marnac
Maurice Roland / Andre Roland (as Vic Winner)

THE TAP-HAPPIEST, SWING-SINGIEST, MELODIC MIRACLE SINCE "ZIEGFELD GIRL"!

These girls are so hot, they need to be put on ice!

This "Lady" Has Taken Her Last Walk!

One of the Commandments of the Mother of the Sea

Self - Founder of the Center for Public Integrity
Self - Professor at University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
Self - Professor at New York University
Self - Visiting Prof. at Massachussets Institute of Technology

It was the longest ride of her life!

From roaring hot rods... to the racing big time
